authorityBoundary: The caller metadata-only request cannot attest ticket type, selection, decision identity, terminal revision or return kind. Independently provisioned source proof and versioned adapter are prerequisites, not present here.

fixtures.why: A positive payout and FINAL claim cannot identify ordinary versus special payout without a source-authenticated exact-ticket return kind.
An authenticated special payout cannot be relabeled as an ordinary winning return or included in research ROI.
A source proof for one bet type cannot establish settlement for another bet type in the same race.
Ticket selection and decision identity must match the independently authenticated source proof, not merely the race.
An earlier ordinary payout cannot be scored after a source-authenticated later terminal correction changes its return kind.
Race-wide labels cannot replace independently authenticated bet-type establishment and ticket-level disposition.
A source-authenticated refund must remain excluded and counted, not be converted into a zero-return loss.
A caller-recomputed commitment or matching SHA-256 transcript is not an issuer-authenticated ticket return-kind proof.

usageRules: These are static negative specifications only; no verifier executes these cases and no positive proof exists.
Keep independent test source proof separate from caller metadata; do not accept claimed FINAL, payout amount, race status or caller digest as authority.
Do not add raw ticket, odds, account identifiers, secrets or private paths to this catalog or the metadata-only request.
Require source-authenticated exact bet type, selection, decision identity, terminal revision and return kind; preserve correction-chain and revocation semantics.
Treat unresolved, special payout, refund and void as unscorable under the unapproved v0.2 candidate; do not infer readiness or ROI.
Never run protected N2 or connect research to Current BUY, LINE, public publishing, automated betting, production settings or Owner Dashboard.
